Salon Services

A wide range of affordable salon services. Let us make you look beautiful.

Haircuts & Styling

Women’s and men’s haircuts, roller sets and everyday styling — finished looks for work, weekends and special occasions.

Color, Highlights & Balayage

Full and partial color, highlights and lowlights, and balayage technique. From natural colors to pastel hues, we mix up almost anything — then follow it with a fresh cut and style.

Keratin & Straightening

Keratin treatments and permanent straightener services for smooth, manageable hair, plus gloss treatments that bring back shine.

Event Up-dos & Weaves

Event up-dos for weddings and special occasions, and full and partial weaves for length and volume.

Children’s Haircuts

Patient, friendly haircuts for kids — the whole family can get their hair done in one visit.

Threading & Waxing

Threading hair removal and face waxing for a clean, finished look.

Look Your Best

Hair is our passion, and our passion shows on every client that walks out of our doors. Through ongoing education, our team stays up to date on the latest cut and color styles and techniques to bring you the looks you want.

Your true colors. From natural colors to pastel hues, our technicians can mix up almost anything. You will leave here with vibrant hair — and a plan to keep it vibrant between visits.

Growing relationships. If you have a look you want but don’t know how to achieve, we can work together to form a plan. Stick with us: we offer a free clean-up cut between your appointments and solid advice on how to keep your hair healthy.
